# Business Registry Search APIs technical specs available now

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Fareen** (5/16/2022):

The Business Registry Search API technical specs are available now and can be used to query the BC Business Registry.
The Business API beta technical specs are also available which can be used to develop APIs for business filings and business registry submissions.
These can be reviewed [here](https://developer.bcregistry.daxiom.ca/apis-summary).

Please provide any feedback or questions on this Discourse forum.
